name: Bloodmage Drazial
summary: At the northern pass, Bloodmage Drazial studies the Blasted Lands with his sister Lynnore. They examine its native beasts and brew mixtures for hardy travelers.

sections.title: Alchemical Studies in the Red Wastes
sections.body:
Near the northern pass between the Swamp of Sorrows and the Blasted Lands, Bloodmage Drazial studies a strange magic. He and his sister Lynnore draw power from the harsh land through blood magic. Many high elves reject such forbidden arts or grieve for Quel'Thalas.

Scorpoks, snickerfangs, and blasted boars thrive with unnatural vigor. Drazial and Lynnore believe the Dark Portal's opening released the energy that changed them. They gather the beasts' organs and tissues, then brew volatile mixtures that grant great strength, agility, and endurance.

sections.title: An Independent Supplier
sections.body: Drazial works apart from the factions stationed in the Blasted Lands. He serves neither the Alliance nor the Horde. Instead, he trades his alchemical skill to anyone hardy enough to cross the wasteland and gather his ingredients. Travelers bring organs from local predators, and his cauldrons keep bubbling.

faq.answer: Near the Blasted Lands' northern entrance, Bloodmage Drazial studies local wildlife and brews alchemical reagents. He is a blood elf mage who works with his sister Lynnore, using parts from corrupted beasts.

faq.q: Why is Drazial collecting animal parts?
aliases: why does drazial want boar lungs
faq.answer: The Blasted Lands' creatures have adapted to blighted, magically charged terrain. Drazial uses potent organs from boars, hyenas, scorpions, and basilisks to brew elixirs that strengthen a warrior's body.

faq.q: Does Drazial work for the Alliance or the Horde?
faq.answer: Drazial is neutral toward both factions. He and Lynnore take no part in the war between Stormwind and the Horde. They deal with any traveler willing to supply their magical and alchemical research.

faq.q: Who is the other blood elf camped with him?
faq.answer: Bloodmage Lynnore is the blood elf camped beside Drazial, and she is his sister. Together they practice blood magic and brew different mixtures from beasts roaming the Blasted Lands.

angles.text: As a mage, you can see how Drazial's craft departs from traditional Kirin Tor spellcraft. He uses blood magic and biological reagents to make arcane enhancements.
